name: ONT_ATL_Housing
purpose: Analytical ontology over the existing aggregate-only Households Served semantic model; not a household identity graph.

tables.DimDate: Reporting calendar. DateKey identifies one date. Snapshot observations exist only for month-start dates in January-December 2025. Calendar contains 2015-2030; AgencyFiscalYear is unapproved and nullable.
tables.DimProgramType: Housing program. ProgramTypeKey is the dimension key; ProgramTypeCode is the stable business label. ProgramFamily distinguishes Unit-based programs from voucher programs.
tables.DimVoucherType: Voucher classification lookup; filter household observations through the existing relationship.
tables.DimActionType: Source action classification lookup; not a source of policy or causal conclusions.
tables.DimIncomeSource: Income source classification codes only, not personal income amounts or eligibility decisions.
tables.DimProperty: Effective-dated property version identified by PropertyKey. PropertyID is a business key, not a unique SCD2 version. Use the existing snapshot-date-resolved relationship.
tables.DimUnit: Source unit dimension including unknown key -1. Missing-unit observations are retained. Do not disclose unit-level or household-identifying detail.
tables.FactHouseholdSnapshot: Households Served observation at household-program-month grain; original household identifiers are deliberately excluded from this model. Use Households and category measures, never invent a unique ontology row key or distinct annual household count. Category precedence Elderly then Disabled then Workforce.
tables.FactUnitAvailability: Program-month unit inventory. EffectiveDateKey plus ProgramTypeKey identifies each inventory observation. Available excludes LIHTC. Voucher inventory is not applicable. Use existing Vacant Units measure and preserve negative values.
tables.FactSupportiveHousing: Supportive roster observations already matched by reporting month, household and own program. Use four VASH/Other measures. Original identifiers are excluded; no unique instance key or fact-to-fact relationship may be invented.
tables.DQ_Results: Disconnected run-level DQ evidence, not an occupancy dimension. Rule counts differ in grain. Use latest run and MAX ObservedCount per rule; never sum repeated historical runs.

rules: Households served means household-program-month observations, not distinct people or annual distinct households.
Require a reporting month for a single snapshot; trends return separate monthly values.
Available excludes LIHTC; vacancy is Available minus Unit Based Households and is blank for voucher programs.
Preserve seeded duplicate-program, missing-unit and negative-vacancy observations.
Keep ProgramScope and personal identifiers outside the ontology; enforce permissions at the source model, not through wording.
This analytical ontology has no invented fact-instance keys and no materialized household identity graph.
